title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown II
hints: Let dp[t] be the maximum profit from completed transactions during the first t days, with no share held at the end. Set dp[0] = 0.
If the last transaction buys on day i and sells on day j, any previous transaction must finish by day i - cooldown - 1. Its contribution is therefore dp[max(0, i - cooldown)].

For each selling day j, try every buying day i < j and add prices[j] - prices[i] - costs[j - i] to the best compatible earlier profit. Also consider making no sale that day. This gives an O(n2) dynamic program
